info.name: API3
info.description: Our Football API 3.0 is a REST API that can be used to request football data from our wide-ranging database and has the following characteristics: - Highly customizable requests - Fast livescores - Reliable and accurate data In addition to the [Football API](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/tutorials-and-guides/tutorials/www.sportmonks.com/football-api), Sportmonks offers a [Prediction API,](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/football-predictions/) [Expected Goals](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/xg-data/) data, a [Premium Odds Feed](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/premium-odds-feed/), a [News API](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/football-news-api/), and multiple [Football Widgets](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/livescore-widget/). The Football API covers over 2,300 leagues, and over 1,350 leagues are covered in the Prediction API. Every continent, country, league, season, stage, round, venue, TV Station, player, coach, referee, bookmaker, market, news article, event, and fixture has its own ID. Head over to our [Getting Started section](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/welcome/making-your-first-request), where you'll create your own API token and create your first request What else do we cover in the documentation? - [Getting started](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football) - [API section](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/api/request-options) - [Endpoint overview](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints) - [Entities explained](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/endpoints-and-entities/entities) - [Tutorials](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/tutorials-and-guides/tutorials) - [How-to guides](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/tutorials-and-guides/guides) - [Definitions](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/definitions/response-codes)

item.description:
The continents endpoint helps you gather an overview of all the continents available within your subscription. You can retrieve basic information or enrich your response. The continents endpoint also helps you assign countries and leagues to the part of the World they belong to.

Use one of our 2 continents endpoints. The details, including base URL, parameters, includes and more, are available per endpoint.

item.description:
The stages endpoint can help you define the structure of the league. A league can have different types of stages, such as regular season, promotion-play-off, knock-outs, etc. With the stages endpoint, we give you the ability to request data for a single stage or a whole season.  
  
Use one of our 4 stages endpoints. The details, including base URL, parameters, includes and more, are available per endpoint.

Most leagues have rounds related to the season. A round represents a week in which a fixture is played. With the rounds endpoint, we give you the ability to request data for a single round or for a whole season.  
  
Use one of our 4 rounds endpoints. The details, including base URL, parameters, includes and more, are available per endpoint.

request.description:
Returns the standing table for a specific round, formatted by group where applicable. If the round standing contains groups (for example, a tournament group stage), the response is structured per group. If no groups are present, the response returns a standard flat standings list.

For more information, please visit:  
[https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints/standings/get-grouped-standings-by-round-id](https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints/standings/get-grouped-standings-by-round-id)

item.description:
Keep track of your favourite teams' season performances. The standings endpoint retrieves full league standing tables.

The response of the standings endpoint can be returned in two formats, depending on the league setup. For ‘normal’ leagues, the response format differs from Cups.

Please check your response carefully if you have cups and 'normal' Leagues in your plan.  
  
Use one of our 5 standings endpoints. The details, including base URL, parameters, includes and more, are available per endpoint.

item.description:
Our **Team Rankings** is a premium data feature that delivers historical and daily-updated **club rankings**, using an Elo-based model. It helps you evaluate club strength over time, whether for pre-match previews, performance modelling, or form-based content.  
  
For more information, please visit  
[https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints/team-rankings-beta](https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints/team-rankings-beta)

item.description:
Enrich your application with betting functionalities. The odds endpoints can be used for In-Play Odds (live), we do have an endpoint for pre-match odds as well.

Use one of our 5 live odds endpoints. Per endpoint, you can find the details, including base URL, parameters, includes and more.

As you may have noticed, we've introduced the **Premium Odds Feed**, which provides access to more bookmakers, faster data updates, and timestamps. For further details, please visit our [Premium Odds Feed section](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints/premium-odds-feed). Please be aware that we've renamed this section due to the introduction of this new odds feed. However, the data offered in this feed remains unchanged. Please note that the Standard Odds Feed is our default offering and provides a more limited set of features and coverage than the **Premium Odds Feed**, which offers a broader range of features and extensive coverage. To access the Premium Odds Feed, please navigate to the [ Premium Odds Feed section](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints/premium-odds-feed) [
](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/endpoints-and-entities/endpoints/predictions/get-value-bets-by-fixture-id)
